Creative.mission: To restore the slide library as the central object of pathology and histology practice.
Creative.vision: A company whose slide-library tool is in every teaching pathology department by 2035.
coreValues: Specific — the slide is the unit of work.
Considered — every feature respects the workflow.
Literary — the case studies are the marketing.
Warm — pathology is craft, and we honour it.
Creative.brandNameRationale: Slide Library is the trade name for the physical and digital archive of microscopy slides held by pathology, histology, and microbiology departments — central to pathology training and practice. The definite article + Co suffix follows the considered-creative trade-name school. Stands in the lineage of declarative-name laboratory brands (The Petri Project, Bench & Beaker).
Creative.manifesto: Pathology has been quietly transformed by digital slide imaging but the central object — the slide library — hasn't been given the design attention it deserves. We started The Slide Library Co to make the digital slide library the focal point of pathology practice, with the reagent supplies, the software, and the educational materials all built around the slide as the unit of work.
Creative.industrySummary: Digital pathology and histology has matured into a recognized category but most software treats the slide as a viewer artefact rather than as a library object. There is real space for a creative-led company that builds around the slide-library workflow with strong educational and reagent-supply components.
Creative.competitorLandscape: Paige.ai (paige.ai) plays the closest peer in pathology AI. PathAI (pathai.com) holds the AI-pathology peer slot. Proscia (proscia.com) sits in the digital-pathology platform middle. Indica Labs (indicalab.com) plays the image-analysis peer position. We sit alongside Proscia with a stronger slide-library and educational focus.
Creative.positioningStatement: The Slide Library Co builds digital slide-library tools and reagent supplies for histology, pathology, and microscopy laboratories.
Creative.positioningRationale: The brand competes on the slide as the central unit of work. The software, the reagents, and the educational materials all build around the slide-library workflow.

messagingPillars.name: Reagent supplies
messagingPillars.description: Reagents for routine histology and pathology workflows, supplied alongside the software. Customers buy both.

messagingPillars.name: Quarterly case studies
messagingPillars.description: Once a quarter the company publishes a long-form case study from an unusual specimen, with full slide imagery and a pathology commentary.
